scope: Four missing adult full-body silhouettes only. Shared paper rim/base and flat black runtime material are integrated separately by root agent.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production Unity 2D upright human paper-pawn BODY sprite. The supplied portrait is IDENTITY reference only, not a background or composition to copy. Extend that exact head/hair silhouette into one complete standing full-body adult, head to both soles. Subject: an adult woman with the same compact high rear hair bun and swept fringe shown in portrait-cook, rounded shoulders, an everyday hooded jacket, practical straight trousers and boots. A simple apron hem may define the outer shape but no interior apron line. Small hands relaxed near the hips; no pot, spoon or weapon. Turn the whole figure slightly toward screen right in a restrained three-quarter stance. Natural adult 6.8-head-tall proportions, not chibi, broad readable outer shapes, both legs visible and feet on the same baseline. Uniform flat solid nearly black fill #171b1a throughout the entire figure. Identity is conveyed solely by the outer contour and true transparent negative spaces between limbs; absolutely zero eyes, skin, face detail, clothing seams, fabric texture, folds, shading, rim light or highlights. NO outline, NO light paper border, NO pedestal, NO base, NO ground shadow, NO floor. Center one figure with 8% clear margin, maximum native portrait resolution; target visible figure 1536–2048px tall. Background MUST be genuinely transparent PNG alpha; all empty space including around and between legs has alpha zero. This is an isolated silhouette cutout layer, no background color, no grid pattern and no display mockup. No labels, text or other objects.
